claim: A versioned predictive instrument can enforce calibration-only selection, untouched holdout scoring, canonical features, explicit missingness, same-path controls, and fail-closed mechanism assertions.

controls.expected: detected because declared mechanism changes nothing
controls.name: no_op_control

data_split.rule: one deterministic permutation frozen before generation

failure_threshold: Any holdout access during selection, prediction/score mismatch, undeclared feature, unchanged destructive control, or non-finite target returns INSTRUMENT_INVALID.
invalidation_conditions: stored predictions differ from scored predictions
feature outside canonical registry reaches fitting
required non-finite value is silently imputed
destructive control leaves its declared source field unchanged
control bypasses the target evaluation path

missingness_policy.optional_features: development-mean imputation with counts reported by split
missingness_policy.required_features: fail closed on any non-finite value
missingness_policy.targets: fail closed on any non-finite value

non_claims: not a repair or rerun of PB-01, PB-02, PB-03, or PB-04
not evidence that HAOS predicts an external system

seed_policy.independent_evidence: fit seeds are repeated fitting only, not independent datasets

stopping_condition: Stop after one deterministic synthetic end-to-end run proves the integrity gates and intended controls; do not optimize predictive score.
success_threshold: All integrity gates pass, all valid controls alter their declared mechanism, both intentionally invalid controls are detected, and a second run is byte-equivalent at the result level.
uncertainty_method: variance across three predeclared repeated fits; no bootstrap sample is treated as independent evidence
